node.control.toggleButton.name: Toggle button
node.control.toggleButton.description: Select the OFF or ON input value. Press or supply a toggle signal to change state; emit a signal only on a change. Reading the selected value never toggles it. State is shared within the workflow and survives restarts.
port.control.toggleButton.in.label: Button label
node.control.button.name: Button
node.control.button.description: Press the button in the editor to emit the input values and one start signal. Filling or connecting a value adds the next input/output pair. Saving, automatic runs and reads from other nodes do not press it.
port.control.button.in.label: Button label
